entries.source_page_scope: PDF pp.2-3, main dynamic audio-tactile experiment

auditory_stimulus.value: A 44.1-kHz pink-noise sample was shaped in SoundForge 4.5 into 3-s IN (55-to-70 dB) and OUT (70-to-55 dB) envelopes, with identical copies crossfaded simultaneously between near and far physical speakers; the exact noise asset and edit project are unavailable.

source_mode.value: Generated dual-loudspeaker apparent motion.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: 44.1-kHz pink-noise samples.

source_recipe_or_asset_provenance.value: No exact audio file, random seed, or SoundForge project.

level_envelope_calibration.value: Exponential 55-70 dB SPL IN and reversed 70-55 dB OUT, measured at the ears.

renderer_apparatus.value: SoundForge 4.5; identical near and far loudspeakers activated simultaneously.

trajectory_kinematics.value: Apparent motion along the right-hand near/far axis: IN crossfaded from the far speaker to the hand-adjacent speaker, while OUT reversed the same approximately 100-cm path over 3000 ms.

motion_mode.value: Continuous intensity-crossfade apparent motion through two speakers.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Right-hand-centred near/far axis.

geometry.value: Near speaker at the hand; far speaker approximately 100 cm from the near speaker.

timing_constraint.value: 3000-ms IN or OUT motion.

padding_or_holds.value: 1000 ms silence before and after the 3-s sound.

attenuation_law.value: Exponential 55-to-70 dB envelope and its reversal, crossfaded between sources.

trial_sequence.value: Each 5-s trial had 1 s silence, a 3-s IN or OUT sound, and 1 s silence; tactile targets occurred at one of seven delays (including silent pre/post baselines), while auditory-only catch trials omitted touch; all trials were randomized.

trial_families.value: IN audio-tactile, OUT audio-tactile, tactile-only pre/post baselines, and IN/OUT auditory-only catches.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Pre-silence -> selected IN/OUT sound -> post-silence, with tactile event at assigned T0-T6 or omitted for catch.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Sound at trial 1000-4000 ms; tactile at trial 300, 1300, 1800, 2500, 3200, 3700, or 4600 ms.

condition_intermixing.value: Random combination of target and catch rows across direction and delay.

task_response.value: Participants said 'TAH' as fast as possible to the electrical tactile target and withheld on auditory-only catches; voice onset was captured by relay, but no online response deadline is reported.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to tactile target; ignore sound and withhold when touch is absent.

response_mode_or_device.value: Voice-activated relay; CIRO task computer.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Say 'TAH' as fast as possible.

scoring_rule.value: Tactile RT; trials beyond two standard deviations were trimmed in analysis.

jitter_iti_policy.value: Trials used fixed 1000-ms silence before and after the 3000-ms sound; no random jitter is reported.

policy_type.value: Fixed padding; no jitter.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: 1000 ms before sound onset and after sound offset within each trial.

values_or_range.value: 1000 ms pre-sound and 1000 ms post-sound.

distribution.value: Fixed timing has no distribution.

soa_schedule.value: Tactile onset relative to sound onset was -700, 300, 800, 1500, 2200, 2700, and +3600 ms (T0-T6); T1-T5 are bimodal and T0/T6 are silent tactile-only baselines.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Tactile onset minus sound onset; negative precedes sound.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.derivation_note: Sound begins 1000 ms after trial start; T0 is trial 300 ms and T6 is trial 4600 ms.

direction_specific_pairing.value: Same T0-T6 schedule for IN and OUT; spatial order reverses with direction.

soa_schedule.derivation_note: Converted the paper's trial-onset times for T0/T6 to the sound-onset reference used by the toolkit.

tactile_target.value: A DS7A constant-current stimulator delivered one 100-ms constant-voltage rectangular monophasic electrical pulse through electrodes on the hairy surface of the right index finger, individually set at 60-90 mA after detection/catch calibration.

modality.value: Electrical tactile pulse via DS7A.

body_site_and_side.value: Hairy surface of right index finger.

waveform_and_duration.value: Single rectangular monophasic pulse, 100 ms.

frequency_or_amplitude.value: 60-90 mA across participants.

intensity_or_calibration.value: Stair-stepped until 10/10 detections and 0/5 false alarms; increased in 5-mA steps if needed.

external_trigger.value: CIRO software controlled stimulus presentation.

baseline_trial_contract.value: Thirty-two tactile-only baselines occurred during silence: T0 (-700 ms from sound onset) and T6 (+3600 ms), eight repetitions for each nominal IN/OUT assignment and endpoint.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Tactile-only unimodal baseline.

timing_and_anchor.value: T0 -700 ms and T6 +3600 ms relative to sound onset.
timing_and_anchor.derivation_note: Converted from trial times 300 and 4600 ms with sound onset at 1000 ms.

allocation_rule.value: Eight per T0/T6 for each nominal IN and OUT condition, randomized with other target/catch rows.

resolved_trial_count.value: 32 baselines.
resolved_trial_count.derivation_note: 2 directions x 2 silent endpoints x 8 repetitions = 32.

crossing_rule.value: Direction label retained even though the tactile event occurs in silence.

baseline_trial_contract.derivation_note: Counts and sound-relative endpoints are arithmetically resolved from the reported seven-delay-by-two-direction target pool.

catch_trial_contract.value: Seventy-six auditory-only IN/OUT trials were randomly intermingled; participants withheld the vocal response.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Auditory-only catch.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No tactile target; withhold 'TAH'.

allocation_rule.value: Randomly intermingled with 112 tactile-target trials.

resolved_trial_count.value: 76 total.

crossing_rule.value: IN/OUT split is not stated.

repetition_allocation.value: Eight tactile-target repetitions at each of seven delays for each of IN and OUT yielded 112 targets (80 critical audio-tactile and 32 tactile-only baseline), plus 76 catches, for 188 total trials.

factor_dimensions.value: Sound direction (IN/OUT) x seven tactile delays, plus auditory-only catch family.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 8 per direction x delay cell; 76 catch trials.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: T0 and T6 are tactile-only baseline cells rather than audio-tactile cells.

derived_total_reconciliation.derivation_note: Critical audio-tactile = 2 x 5 x 8 = 80; baseline = 2 x 2 x 8 = 32.

repetition_allocation.derivation_note: Resolved critical and baseline subsets from the exhaustive reported cell design.

block_order_contract.value: The 188 randomized trials were equally split into two blocks of 94, each lasting about 8 minutes.

block_composition.value: 94 trials per block drawn equally from the full randomized pool.

pool_repeat_or_distribution.value: One complete 188-trial pool distributed equally across two blocks.

within_block_randomization.value: Random target/catch combination.

block_order_or_counterbalancing.value: Blocks do not represent distinct conditions.

sequence_constraints.value: Two consecutive approximately 8-min task blocks; break details not reported.

block_order_contract.derivation_note: Per-block count is derived from the reported equal division.

auditory_stimulus.value: A broadband/white-noise source was rendered by a custom 16-speaker array as a 2-m approach, prerecorded binaurally with 3Dio microphones, and replayed via BOSE QC15 headphones; the exact sound track, rendering code, and gain law are not supplied.
auditory_stimulus.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-6, Acoustic Stimuli and Experiment 2

source_mode.value: Prerecorded binaural playback of a 16-loudspeaker apparent-motion source.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: Broadband/white-noise moving sound.

source_recipe_or_asset_provenance.value: Exact stereo file and software algorithm are referenced to prior work but not supplied here.

level_envelope_calibration.value: Dynamic intensity is described, but numeric gain anchors are not reported here.

renderer_apparatus.value: Two eight-speaker JBL arrays/M-Audio interface, 3Dio binaural microphones, BOSE QC15 headphones, ExpyVR control.

trajectory_kinematics.value: The sound and virtual ball approached the face together from 2 m at 75 cm/s; the visible approach lasted 2600 ms, followed by a 400-ms stationary hold and 500 ms without stimulation in a 5-s trial.
trajectory_kinematics.page_or_section: PDF pp.4-6, Figs. 3-4 and Experiment 2 Procedure

motion_mode.value: Prerecorded binaural auditory approach synchronized with virtual visual approach.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Frontal face-centred trajectory terminating at the participant.

geometry.value: 2-m virtual path toward the face.

timing_constraint.value: 75 cm/s; 2600-ms moving segment.

padding_or_holds.value: 400-ms end hold, then 500 ms no stimulation; trial totals 5000 ms with fixation timing.

trial_sequence.value: Trimodal audiovisual-tactile targets, tactile-only baselines, and audiovisual-only catches were intermingled; fixation lasted 1200 ms and motion began 300 ms after fixation offset in a 5000-ms trial.
trial_sequence.page_or_section: PDF pp.5-6, Experimental Design and Procedure

trial_families.value: Audiovisual-tactile target, tactile-only baseline, and audiovisual-only catch.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Fixation -> 300-ms gap -> synchronized ball/sound approach -> optional cheek touch at one of five delays -> hold/no-stimulation completion.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: 1200-ms intertrial fixation; motion begins 300 ms later; 2600-ms approach, 400-ms hold, 500-ms no stimulation; 5000-ms total.

condition_intermixing.value: Target, baseline, and catch families intermingled across four blocks.

task_response.value: Participants pressed a button as rapidly and accurately as possible to the 10-ms right-cheek touch and withheld on audiovisual-only catches; response device details and online deadline are not reported.
task_response.page_or_section: PDF pp.5-6, Experimental Design and Procedure

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to cheek touch; withhold when only audiovisual stimuli occur.

response_mode_or_device.value: Button press; specific device/hand not stated.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Rapid, accurate button press to touch.

scoring_rule.value: Tactile RT; catch accuracy checked; multimodal RT corrected by fastest tactile-only baseline.

jitter_iti_policy.value: A fixed 1200-ms fixation appeared between trials; the next approach began 300 ms after fixation offset, with no random jitter reported.

policy_type.value: Fixed intertrial fixation and post-fixation gap.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: 1200-ms fixation between trials; 300 ms from fixation offset to approach onset.

values_or_range.value: 1200 ms plus 300 ms.

distribution.value: Fixed timing.

soa_schedule.value: Five tactile delays/distances were used, but their numeric onset times or distance anchors are not reported in this paper.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Tactile onset relative to audiovisual-motion/trial onset.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.value: Only five levels are stated.

direction_specific_pairing.value: Only approaching motion.

tactile_target.value: An MSTC-3 mechanical solenoid delivered a 10-ms tactile stimulus to the participant's right cheek under ExpyVR control.

modality.value: Mechanical solenoid tapper (MSTC-3, M&E Solve).

body_site_and_side.value: Right cheek.

waveform_and_duration.value: 10-ms mechanical tactile event.

external_trigger.value: Custom ExpyVR controlled sensory synchronization.

baseline_trial_contract.value: Tactile-only baselines comprised approximately 20% of trials and used the same five temporal delays; the stated 12 trials per delay for each unimodal condition does not fully disambiguate all condition crossings.
baseline_trial_contract.page_or_section: PDF pp.5-6, Experimental Design and Procedure

family_or_explicit_none.value: Unimodal tactile baseline.

timing_and_anchor.value: Same five delays as trimodal targets; numeric delays absent.

allocation_rule.value: Intermingled; 20% design share and 12 trials per delay for each unimodal condition are stated.

resolved_trial_count.value: 20% of 540 implies 108, but the paper's terse per-condition count cannot be independently reconciled without omitted condition labels.

crossing_rule.value: The hidden condition dimension underlying 'each unimodal condition' is not enumerated.

catch_trial_contract.value: Audiovisual-only catches required response withholding; the paper states both a 10% design share and 60 catch trials, which conflict for 540 total (10% would be 54).
catch_trial_contract.page_or_section: PDF pp.5-6, Experimental Design and Procedure

family_or_explicit_none.value: Audiovisual-only catch.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No tactile target; withhold response.

allocation_rule.value: Intermingled; nominally 10% of trials.

resolved_trial_count.value: 60 explicitly stated versus 54 implied by 10% of 540.

repetition_allocation.value: Experiment 2 reports 540 total, 12 trials per delay for each trimodal condition, 12 per delay for each unimodal condition, and 60 catches; omitted condition labels and the 70/20/10 percentages prevent a unique cell-level reconciliation.
repetition_allocation.page_or_section: PDF pp.5-6, Experimental Design and Procedure

factor_dimensions.value: Trial family x five tactile delays, with an unenumerated condition dimension.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 12 per delay per trimodal condition; 12 per delay per unimodal condition; 60 catch; 540 total.

source_mode.value: Physical loudspeakers in behavioral session; headphone rendering in scanner.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: 3100-ms pink-noise looming and flat-control sounds.

source_recipe_or_asset_provenance.value: Envelope/end levels are reported, but exact waveforms and headphone spatial-rendering assets are not.

trajectory_kinematics.value: Behavioral looming sound was represented as approaching from 100 cm to the right hand over 3100 ms; five reported touch delays map to perceived distances 97.7, 95.3, 88.6, 70.5, and 41.7 cm. motion_mode.value: Intensity-based auditory looming versus flat control.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Right-hand-centered near endpoint in behavioral session.

geometry.value: Nominal 100-cm-to-hand approach; exact physical/virtual path and scanner coordinate mapping are not fully specified.

timing_constraint.value: 3100-ms sound.

trial_sequence.value: Behavioral rows crossed looming/flat sounds with five tactile delays and intermixed catches. fMRI rows crossed looming/flat with individually selected near/far tactile delays; right-index touch was the experimental target and left-index touch cued a catch response.
trial_sequence.page_or_section: PDF pp.9-11, Behavioral and fMRI experiments

trial_families.value: Behavioral audio-tactile targets plus catches; fMRI four right-touch experimental cells plus left-touch catch cells.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Sound onset, condition-specific tactile event, then response/ITI; fMRI cell order pseudorandomized.

task_response.value: Behavioral session: press with the left index as quickly as possible after right-index touch while ignoring sound. fMRI session: no response to right-index experimental touch; press with the left middle finger to left-index catch touch. Deadlines are not reported.
task_response.page_or_section: PDF pp.9-11, Behavioral and fMRI experiments

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Session-specific tactile-detection/go-no-go rules.

response_mode_or_device.value: Manual button response; exact device is not reported.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Behavioral left-index response to right touch; scanner left-middle response only to left-touch catches.

jitter_iti_policy.value: Behavioral trials used a fixed 1000-ms intertrial interval. fMRI trials used a variable intertrial interval, but its values/distribution are not reported in this PDF.

policy_type.value: Fixed behavioral ITI; variable scanner ITI.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: Between successive trials.

values_or_range.value: 1000 ms behavioral; scanner range unreported.

soa_schedule.value: Behavioral tactile onsets were 300, 800, 1500, 2200, or 2700 ms after sound onset. Each participant's scanner task used one individually selected near and one far delay from those five.
soa_schedule.page_or_section: PDF pp.9-10, Behavioral experiment and fMRI task

reference_event_and_sign.value: Positive tactile delay from sound onset.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.value: Behavioral 300/800/1500/2200/2700 ms; scanner individualized near/far subset.

tactile_target.value: Suprathreshold electrical stimulation was delivered through electrode pairs on the index fingers (right for behavioral and scanner experimental trials; left for scanner catches); pulse waveform and duration are not stated.
tactile_target.page_or_section: PDF pp.9-10, Behavioral experiment and fMRI task

modality.value: Electrical cutaneous stimulation.

body_site_and_side.value: Index fingers; right experimental, left scanner catch.

baseline_trial_contract.value: Neither session includes a tactile-only baseline family; all reported tactile trials occur with looming or flat auditory stimulation.

family_or_explicit_none.value: No tactile-only baseline family.

timing_and_anchor.value: No baseline timing.

allocation_rule.value: No baseline allocation.

catch_trial_contract.value: Behavioral catches were intermixed but their number and exact target omission are not reported here. Scanner catches used left-index rather than right-index touch and required a left-middle response: 20 catches for each of four conditions (80 total).
catch_trial_contract.page_or_section: PDF pp.9-11, Behavioral experiment and fMRI task

family_or_explicit_none.value: Behavioral catch family; scanner side-switched tactile-response catch.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: Scanner rule explicit; behavioral catch mechanics not fully specified.

allocation_rule.value: Behavioral intermixed; scanner 20 per condition.

resolved_trial_count.value: Scanner 80; behavioral count unreported.

repetition_allocation.value: Behavioral session reports 18 target trials for each temporal delay in each looming/flat condition (180 target rows), plus an unreported number of catches. Scanner task reports 48 experimental and 20 catch trials per each of four conditions (272 total).
repetition_allocation.page_or_section: PDF pp.9-11, Behavioral and fMRI experiments

factor_dimensions.value: Behavioral sound condition x five delays; scanner sound condition x individualized near/far delay x experimental/catch family.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: Behavioral 18 per sound-by-delay cell but catch count absent; scanner 48 active + 20 catch per condition = 272.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Behavioral and scanner sessions use different cell definitions/counts; scanner near/far delays are individually selected.

block_order_contract.value: Behavioral experiment comprised three blocks. Scanner experiment comprised eight approximately 6-min runs, with pseudorandom order permitting only two or three consecutive trials of the same condition.

block_count.value: 3 behavioral blocks; 8 fMRI runs.

block_composition.value: Behavioral allocation across blocks unreported; scanner trials distributed across eight runs.

auditory_stimulus.value: A 1000-ms pink-noise probe moved through four consecutive physical loudspeakers with cosine windows; exact noise asset and per-speaker gain table are unavailable.

source_mode.value: Generated pink-noise bursts played sequentially over a ten-speaker physical array.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: Pink-noise moving probe with 10-ms rise/fall.

source_recipe_or_asset_provenance.value: Cosine-window method is reported, but exact waveform and per-speaker gains are not.

trajectory_kinematics.value: Front and rear 48-cm approaches at 48 cm/s over 1 s, beginning at 96, 144, or 192 cm and using four consecutive 16-cm-spaced speakers.

motion_mode.value: Sequential physical-loudspeaker approach.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: 0-degree front or 180-degree rear relative to the head; speakers at chest height.

geometry.value: Ten speakers from 48 to 192 cm in 16-cm steps; three starting distances 96/144/192 cm, each moving 48 cm inward.

timing_constraint.value: 1000-ms probe, 48-cm path, 48 cm/s.

trial_sequence.value: A 500-ms 1000-Hz all-speaker cue, 1000-ms interval, then a 1000-ms probe or matched no-probe row; tactile events occur 250/500/750 ms into the probe and all conditions randomize within block.

trial_families.value: Audio-tactile probe, tactile-only baseline, probe-only catch, and no-probe/no-tactile catch.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: 500-ms cue; 1000-ms gap; 1000-ms probe/no-probe interval with condition-specific tactile event; randomized row order.

task_response.value: Participants closed their eyes and responded as quickly as possible to chest vibration using a numeric keypad; no online response deadline is reported.
task_response.page_or_section: PDF pp.8 and 10-11, Apparatus and PPS task

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to tactile-present probe/baseline trials; withhold on both catch families.

response_mode_or_device.value: Numeric keypad.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Speeded tactile-detection keypress.

jitter_iti_policy.value: The between-trial interval was randomly selected from 1000 to 1500 ms.

policy_type.value: Random interval range.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: Between the end of a trial and the next trial cue.

soa_schedule.value: Probe tactile onsets were 250, 500, and 750 ms after probe onset; baseline tactile onsets were matched at 1250, 1500, and 1750 ms after the trial-start cue.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Probe SOAs are positive from probe onset; baseline timings are positive from the 500-ms start cue.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.value: Probe: 250/500/750 ms crossed with 96/144/192-cm starting distances; baseline: 1250/1500/1750 ms from cue.

tactile_target.value: A 0.95-cm SHICOH C1034 stimulator delivered 300-Hz, 100-ms suprathreshold vibration to the chest.

modality.value: Vibrotactile stimulator.

body_site_and_side.value: Chest.

waveform_and_duration.value: 300-Hz vibration lasting 100 ms, far above threshold.

baseline_trial_contract.value: Twelve tactile-only baseline trials per direction block: three cue-referenced timings x four repetitions, timing-matched to probe trials.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Tactile-only, no-probe baseline.

timing_and_anchor.value: 1250/1500/1750 ms after the start cue, matching probe tactile timing.

allocation_rule.value: Four repetitions per timing, randomized with other rows.

resolved_trial_count.value: 12 per block; 24 overall.

catch_trial_contract.value: Eight catches per direction block: two repetitions at each of three probe distances without touch plus two no-probe/no-touch rows.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Probe-only and empty catch families.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No tactile target; withhold response.

allocation_rule.value: Randomized with probe and baseline trials.

resolved_trial_count.value: 8 per block; 16 overall.

repetition_allocation.value: Per direction: 3 distances x 3 tactile timings x 4 = 36 probes; 3 baseline timings x 4 = 12; 8 catches; 56 total. Two directions give 112 trials.

factor_dimensions.value: Direction block x probe start distance x tactile timing, plus baseline timing and catch subtype.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: Four per probe distance/timing and baseline timing; two per catch distance plus two empty catches; 112 total.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: One participant was excluded after recording; no per-cell count exception is reported for analyzed participants.

block_order_contract.value: Two 56-trial blocks, front and rear, with randomized rows; the direction-block order is not explicitly reported.
block_order_contract.page_or_section: PDF pp.10-11, Procedure and PPS task

block_count.value: Two direction blocks, 56 trials each.

block_composition.value: 36 probe + 12 baseline + 8 catch rows per block.

trajectory_kinematics.value: The far loudspeaker was 1 m beyond the near loudspeaker beside the participant's hand; reciprocal far-decreasing/near-exponentially-increasing intensity ramps produced an apparent far-to-near approach over 3 s. auditory_stimulus.value: A 3250-ms 44.1-kHz burst train was rendered in Max/MSP 6.1.10/Spat with direct sound, early reflections, late reverberation, and LISTEN HRTFs into fixed and looming stereo assets; exact files/project are not supplied.

source_mode.value: Prerecorded binaural virtual fixed/looming playback.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: 3250-ms burst train, 44.1 kHz.

source_recipe_or_asset_provenance.value: Exact burst train, rendered WAVs, and Max/MSP project absent; cites Hobeika protocol.

renderer_apparatus.value: Max/MSP 6.1.10, Spat, LISTEN nonindividual HRTFs, direct/early/late room rendering, Beyerdynamic DT770.

trajectory_kinematics.value: The looming source moved at ear level in the frontal-left hemispace (45-degree azimuth) from 640 to 20 cm at 210 cm/s during the 3250-ms asset; the fixed control remained at 640 cm.

motion_mode.value: Binaural continuous looming versus fixed distant control.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Head-centred, frontal-left 45-degree azimuth, ear level.

geometry.value: 640-to-20 cm looming; fixed at 640 cm.

timing_constraint.value: 210 cm/s; 3250-ms file with sampled anchors through 3050 ms.

padding_or_holds.value: 300-ms pre-sound silence and random 1000-1400-ms post-sound silence.

attenuation_law.value: Room model stated, numeric distance/gain law absent.

trial_sequence.value: Trials had 300 ms silence, one fixed/looming 3250-ms sound, a left-hand phone vibration at one of six delays or no vibration for catch, then random 1000-1400-ms silence; participants tapped the screen and received visual confirmation.

trial_families.value: Looming audio-tactile, fixed audio-tactile expectancy control, and auditory-only catch.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Pre-silence -> select/play fixed or looming sound -> vibrate at T1-T6 or omit -> touchscreen tap/feedback -> post-silence.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Tactile at 105, 1625, 2385, 2765, 2955, 3050 ms after sound onset; post-silence 1000-1400 ms.

condition_intermixing.value: Experimental/catch trials presented within six blocks; app reports flags per trial.

task_response.value: Participants tapped the smartphone screen whenever they felt the left-hand vibration, ignored sound, and withheld on auditory-only catches; the analysis retained 100-1000-ms RT, but no online deadline is stated.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to phone vibration; withhold when vibration absent.

response_mode_or_device.value: Pixel 2 XL touchscreen tap detected/bound through embedded accelerometer and touch event; CSV output.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Tap screen rapidly without anticipation.

response_window_and_anchor.value: Online cutoff is not reported; offline valid RT was 100-1000 ms from tactile onset.

scoring_rule.value: Tactile RT by sound movement and delay; misses/false alarms and 100-1000-ms filter.

jitter_iti_policy.value: Sound was preceded by fixed 300-ms silence and followed by a randomly distributed 1000-1400-ms silent period.

policy_type.value: Random post-sound interval plus fixed pre-sound padding.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: 300 ms before sound; 1000-1400 ms after sound.

values_or_range.value: 300 ms fixed; 1000-1400 ms random.

distribution.value: Randomly distributed within range; exact distribution not named.

soa_schedule.value: Tactile onset minus sound onset was 105, 1625, 2385, 2765, 2955, or 3050 ms, mapping the looming source to 640, 320, 160, 80, 40, or 20 cm; fixed control used the same SOAs at 640 cm.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Phone-vibration onset minus auditory-file onset.

direction_specific_pairing.value: Same six times for looming and fixed; only looming changes distance.

tactile_target.value: The Google Pixel 2 XL haptic motor delivered a 50-ms, 155-Hz vibration at maximum amplitude to the phone held in the left hand.

modality.value: Embedded smartphone haptic-motor vibration.

body_site_and_side.value: Left hand holding phone.

waveform_and_duration.value: 50-ms vibration.

frequency_or_amplitude.value: 155 Hz at maximum amplitude.

intensity_or_calibration.value: Maximum device amplitude; accelerometer threshold calibrated during pilot/UI work.

external_trigger.value: Dynaspace Android app scheduled vibration.

baseline_trial_contract.value: The fixed-distant audio-tactile condition served as the explicit temporal-expectancy control at the same six SOAs, with 24 repetitions per SOA (144 fixed-control trials); no tactile-only baseline was used.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Fixed-sound audio-tactile expectancy baseline/control.

timing_and_anchor.value: Same T1-T6 schedule as looming; source fixed at 640 cm.

allocation_rule.value: Crossed with all six delays at 24 repetitions.

crossing_rule.value: Sound movement fixed x six delays.

baseline_trial_contract.derivation_note: The fixed-control count is derived as six delays multiplied by 24 reported repetitions.

catch_trial_contract.value: Auditory-only catches were interspersed; six blocks x 24 catches implies 144 and reconciles 432 total, but the paper prints 184 catches and Fig. 9 says 76 rather than 72 trials per block.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Auditory-only catch.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No phone vibration; withhold screen tap.

allocation_rule.value: 24 catches per each of six blocks.

resolved_trial_count.value: 144 implied by 6 x 24 and 432-288; source prints 184.

crossing_rule.value: Fixed/looming catch split not stated.

repetition_allocation.value: Twenty-four repetitions crossed 2 sound movements x 6 delays (288 experimental); total 432 and 6 blocks x (48 experimental +24 catch) imply 144 catches, conflicting with printed 184 and a 76-trial figure caption.

factor_dimensions.value: Sound movement (fixed/looming) x six delays, plus auditory-only catch.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 24 per 12 experimental cells; 48 experimental +24 catch per block x six blocks.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Printed 184 catches and 76 trials per block disagree with internally consistent 144 catches/72 per block.

block_order_contract.value: Six nominal 3-min blocks each contained 48 experimental and 24 catch trials (72), with short breaks and a mandatory 10-min midpoint break; a figure caption instead says 76 and an earlier app description says five practice plus 72 recorded trials per block.

block_count.value: 6 experimental blocks.

block_composition.value: Text: 48 experimental +24 catch=72; Fig. 9: 76; app overview: five practice then 72 recorded.

pool_repeat_or_distribution.value: Twenty-four repetitions per 12-cell grid distributed across blocks.

block_order_or_counterbalancing.value: Blocks do not encode distinct treatment levels.

sequence_constraints.value: Short break between blocks; mandatory 10-min break after block 3; five unrecorded practice trials at block start per app description.

entries.evidence_note: Behavioral participant experiment is distinct from the device-timing validation and retains the source's catch/block arithmetic conflicts.

auditory_stimulus.value: A 2-s pink-noise source was synthesized in MATLAB with HRTF cues, propagation delay, and room-temperature air attenuation to move laterally from the participant's right toward the head; the exact noise asset, HRTFs, and referenced code are not supplied in this paper.
auditory_stimulus.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-4, Experimental Design and Apparatus

source_mode.value: Prerecorded/synthesized stereo HRTF virtual moving source.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: Pink-noise looming asset, 2 s.

source_recipe_or_asset_provenance.value: MATLAB HRTF method follows reference [10], but exact code/noise/HRTF assets are absent.

level_envelope_calibration.value: Propagation and attenuation factor for room-temperature air; numeric law/level calibration absent.

renderer_apparatus.value: MATLAB synthesis; Psychtoolbox playback through WASAPI and DAC to Sennheiser HDA 300 headphones.

trajectory_kinematics.value: A right-lateral straight trajectory approached the participant's head from 100 cm to 0 cm at 50 cm/s over 2 s.
trajectory_kinematics.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-4, Experimental Design and Apparatus

motion_mode.value: Continuous HRTF-rendered lateral approach.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Head-centred right-to-head lateral path.

geometry.value: 100-to-0 cm straight path.

timing_constraint.value: 2 s at 50 cm/s.

padding_or_holds.value: Trial onset 1000 ms after fixation appears; no static source hold reported.

attenuation_law.value: Room-temperature propagation/attenuation factor included; exact formula absent.

trial_sequence.value: One second after fixation appeared, each trial selected 2-second tactile-only baseline, 2-second audio-tactile looming target, or auditory-only catch; touch occurred at one of seven SOAs; participants pressed a button when touch was felt.
trial_sequence.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-4, Experimental Design and Apparatus

trial_families.value: Tactile-only baseline, audio-tactile looming target, and auditory-only catch.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Fixation -> 1000-ms wait -> play silence or looming audio track plus the assigned haptic track -> button response; catch omits haptic track.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Tactile event at 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1500, 1750 ms after audio-track/trial onset; 200-ms sawtooth embedded in duration-matched channel.

condition_intermixing.value: Baseline/audio-tactile repetitions and 21 catches interspersed within the experiment.

task_response.value: Participants pressed a Cherry MX Blue button with the left hand as soon as the right-palm vibration was felt and withheld on auditory-only catches; no online deadline is reported.
task_response.page_or_section: PDF pp.2-4, Experimental Design and Apparatus

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to tactile vibration in baseline/audio-tactile trials; withhold for sound-only catch.

response_mode_or_device.value: Cherry MX Blue button; Psychtoolbox response log.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Press as soon as vibration is felt.

scoring_rule.value: RT adjusted from trial onset by tactile SOA; negative/multiple responses excluded; >2.5-SD values trimmed.

jitter_iti_policy.value: Trial onset was fixed 1000 ms after fixation-cross appearance; the post-response intertrial interval and any jitter distribution are not reported.

policy_type.value: Fixed prestimulus fixation; post-trial policy absent.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: 1000 ms from fixation appearance to trial/audio-track onset.

values_or_range.value: 1000 ms before trial onset; post-trial value not reported.

soa_schedule.value: Tactile onset minus 2-second audio-track onset was 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1500, 1750 ms, seven equally spaced points that map to the constant-speed trajectory.
soa_schedule.page_or_section: PDF pp.3-4, Experimental Design and Stimuli

reference_event_and_sign.value: Tactile/haptic-track onset minus looming-audio-track onset.

direction_specific_pairing.value: Only approach direction.

tactile_target.value: An audio-driven haptic actuator under a molded silicone pad at the right palm delivered a 200-ms, 80-Hz sawtooth generated in Audacity on a DAC-synchronized audio channel.

modality.value: Audio-driven haptic actuator.

body_site_and_side.value: Right palm on molded silicone pad.

waveform_and_duration.value: Sawtooth, 200 ms.

frequency_or_amplitude.value: 80 Hz; amplitude not reported.

intensity_or_calibration.value: Demonstrated before task; no threshold/amplitude calibration reported.

external_trigger.value: Duration-matched tactile audio track synchronized with auditory track through DAC/WASAPI.

baseline_trial_contract.value: The tactile-only baseline used the same seven SOAs and 16 repetitions per SOA, yielding 112 baseline trials in the 2-second experiment.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Tactile-only baseline condition.

timing_and_anchor.value: Nominal trial/audio-track anchors at 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1500, 1750 ms, without looming sound.

allocation_rule.value: 16 repetitions at each of seven temporal delays.

crossing_rule.value: Baseline is experiment-specific and uses the 2-second SOA grid.

catch_trial_contract.value: Twenty-one 2-second auditory-only catches were interspersed; no response was expected.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Auditory-only catch.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No tactile stimulation; withhold button press.

allocation_rule.value: Interspersed with 224 tactile-target trials.

crossing_rule.value: Single looming sound duration within this experiment.

repetition_allocation.value: Sixteen repetitions crossed two conditions (baseline/audio-tactile) with seven 2-second delays: 224 tactile-target trials (112 per condition), plus 21 catches = 245.

factor_dimensions.value: Baseline/audio-tactile condition x seven delay cells, plus catch.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 16 per condition-by-delay; 21 catches.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Five practice trials and post-task questionnaire are outside the 245 outcome trials.

block_order_contract.value: The 2-second experiment contained one 245-trial PPS block with two scheduled within-block breaks, followed by a questionnaire; experiment order was semi-counterbalanced across participants.

block_count.value: One 245-trial PPS block/run with two scheduled breaks.

block_composition.value: 112 baseline +112 audio-tactile +21 catch.

pool_repeat_or_distribution.value: One complete experiment-specific pool.

within_block_randomization.value: Catch trials interspersed; precise row randomization algorithm not stated.

block_order_or_counterbalancing.value: Two-second first for 7 participants and three-second first for 6.

sequence_constraints.value: PPS task then questionnaire, then the other experiment; two scheduled breaks within each PPS run.
